title: Worthless
text: Worthless. Not able to do what it's advertised to do.  Wire is too flimsy to go under any type of thread.  Could be used for threading a needle, but that's not what I bought it for!

product_metadata.title: LoRan 40033 Tail End Weaver, Pink 2 Piece
features: Weave loose ends under existing stitches
Assists in last stitch when thread becomes too short
Pulls threads and loose garment strings back into place
description: Use the Loran Tail End Weaver to weave loose ends under existing stitches, and to assist in last stitch when thread becomes too short. Pulls threads and loose garment strings back into place. Weave loose thread ends on the back of needlework for a professional look.
